notes.title: Announcing Cyber Seekers: Conquest | Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
Cyber Seekers: Conquest is a fast-paced Rogue Lite shooter where you play as a bot and use dynamic wall running and a grapple gun to traverse a city and hunt down other bots who have gone rogue. Find unique weapons and abilities in the city and equip them to become a superior Seeker.

[previewyoutube=j4vyYDT-Fig;full][/previewyoutube]

After developing Rogue Bots, I started expanding the existing mechanics, focusing primarily on traversal. Cyber Seekers has dynamic wall-running, allowing the player to traverse any terrain. This can be used to complete various traversal challenges in the game, which rewards you with Credits and Schematics. Use these to upgrade your bot and make subsequent runs easier. 

Your task is to destroy Rogue Bots and reduce their presence. Each bot that you destroy increases the alert level. The bots become more aggressive at high alert levels, but you get access to weapons with significantly better traits. If your bot gets destroyed, you will lose all your weapons and abilities but retain the upgrades purchased using Schematics.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] The city is your playground: Utilize wall running and grappling for fast paced traversal.
[*] Rogue Lite Adventure: Get random weapons with distinct bonuses on each run.
[*] Slot new Modules: Use powerful abilities like Telekinesis and Hacking.
[*] Endless Replayability: Face different enemies and install programs that give a special buff. Each run in unique.
[*] Test your skills: Complete various traversal challenges across the city and receive credits to upgrade your bot.
[/list]

Right now, you can check the [b]Demo for Cyber Seekers[/b] available on Steam.

notes.title: Rogue Bots v2.0 update
notes.content:
Got some time to work on addressing some of the issues and content that I wanted to add. This post is an announcement for the same and details the changes made to the game.

Huge thanks to everyone who played the game after its release and gave their feedback.

List of all changes made to the game.
[list]
[*]Added new ability: Cyber Blast.
[*]Added new weapon: Rifle
[*]Added new melee weapon: Axe.
[*]Added new attack for melee.
[*]Added content: 2 new levels.
[*]Added 2 new enemy types: Drones and bots with shield.
[*]Added video tutorials for better explanation of abilities.
[*]Bots now spawn ammo and cells when neutralized.
[*]Power cell now explodes on impact and can be shot only through SX-31.
[*]Power cell explosion no longer neutralizes enemy instantly.
[*]Added Rifle ability: Spawn multiple rifles.
[*]Added SX-31 ability: Shoot power cell.
[*]Added physical animation for bots when hit by rifle bullet.
[*]Changes to particle effects when bot neutralized.
[*]Changes to particle effects when standing near generator.
[*]Changed hit marker when bot neutralized.
[*]Changed look of some levels.
[*]Added sound and particle effects for bot when attacking.
[*]Added weapon switch effects.
[*]Added particle effect for bot when hits ground.
[*]Fixed an issue in one level where bots were able to shoot through walls.
[/list]

Again, it will be beneficial for the game if you can post about any game breaking glitches or bugs you encounter in the game on the forum or send me a mail. I will try to fix them as soon as possible.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Rogue Bots Released!
notes.content:
I'm so excited to announce that my first game Rogue Bots has been released on Steam. 

It has been a great journey developing this game. The concept of this game came to my mind as I was learning to make games. Every step of the game the mechanics were tested and changed to make the gameplay better and fun. I had many more plans for this game but was unable to implement all of them as I developed this game alone.

Through this announcement I would also like to announce about the future updates and bug fixes.

I have plans to add more content to the game later this year. These plans include adding more guns, enemy types and maps to the survival mode and extending the story mode. However I cannot give a particular date on which these updates will roll out as I am currently busy with other things. Rest assured, you will be informed about every update through announcements. I plan to keep this community very active and will respond to whatever question you have.

A few small glitches in the game will be fixed in a future update. Any kind of feedback or suggestion is welcome. It will be beneficial for the game if you can post about any game breaking glitches or bugs you encounter in the game on the forum or send me a mail. Such kind of bugs will be immediately looked after and fixed.

A big thanks to everyone who played the game pre-release and provided me with some feedback.

I hope you all enjoy playing the game and have as much fun as I have had making it.

Happy gaming!
